en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from his father from Abi Basir from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:
One who recites Surah Saff and is regular in reciting it in the obligatory prayers, Allah includes him in the row of His angels, prophets and messengers, Insha Allah.
